reference: PostgreSQL field-scoped text witness and SQL residuals

profile.description: Exact unranked text candidates with independently evaluated PostgreSQL residuals
profile.view_sql: CREATE VIEW support_view AS SELECT d._id,r.title AS title_text,r.status,r.metadata->>'plan' AS plan,r.metadata->>'region' AS region,(r.metrics->>'score')::numeric AS score,(r.flags->>'published')::boolean AS published,r.tags AS tag_list,r.metadata,r.note FROM docs d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(d._doc) AS r(title TEXT,status TEXT,metadata JSONB,metrics JSONB,flags JSONB,tags TEXT[],note TEXT)

entries.sql: SELECT _id, plan FROM support_view WHERE full_text_search('metadata.plan:pro') AND status = 'active' LIMIT 5
entries.reference_sql: SELECT _id, plan FROM support_view WHERE _id IN (SELECT candidate._id FROM docs candidate WHERE to_tsvector('simple',coalesce(candidate._doc #>> '{metadata,plan}','')) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple','pro')) AND status = 'active' LIMIT 5
